newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to extradite German wanted for torture.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to extradite German wanted for torture.

text.p: Brazil's highest court has approved the extradition of a German doctor wanted in Germany on charges of torturing and sexually abusing women, including one who died after being drugged, officials said on Friday.
A court official said Gerd Wenzinger, 54, would be flown to Germany within two months after the Supreme Federal Tribunal Thursday upheld a request for his extradition by prosecutors in Berlin.
Wenzinger was arrested in the northeastern city of Salvador a year ago.
He was alleged to have filmed the torture and sexual abuse of patients and prostitutes he drugged, an official at the German Embassy in Brasilia said.
One prostitute died in 1994, allegedly after being anaesthetised by Wenzinger, the official said.
